title: Surreal Desert Shore
description: A woman in a green and purple dress and hat stands on rocky tide pools at the left, holding an orange celestial orb. A knight in armor stands on a sandy beach path leading toward a large pyramid under a giant golden fleur-de-lis floating in a colorful cloud formation that contains miniature landscapes and faces.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a rocky shoreline meeting a sandy desert with a large orange pyramid in the background. A woman in a flowing green and purple medieval dress and wide hat stands on tide pools holding a glowing orange orb. A silver knight stands on the beach. Above floats a giant ornate golden fleur-de-lis inside a purple cloud containing tiny trees, a tent, and faces. A large red sun sets on the horizon over turquoise water under a dramatic orange and blue sky.
